choose.otherwise: AND r.instance_id IS NULL AND r.event_id IS NULL

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT r.instance_id FROM iws_process_request_detail r LEFT JOIN iws_process_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE r.instance_id IS NOT NULL AND r.event_id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.instance_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT r.event_id FROM iws_process_request_detail r LEFT JOIN iws_process_instance i ON i.id = r.instance_id WHERE r.event_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
